d: Prakashan, after drinking, encounters Vinod and a young woman near a carpenter's abode.
Kichu is a heartless student leader who can go to any extent for power. He is asked to donate his blood to save a man named Krishnan, whose story changes him for the better.
Debt-ridden Govinda convinces a suicidal, rich Suryan to live for a year so he can profit from Suryan's insurance policy. However, Suryan falls in love with Govinda's daughter and wants to live.
Fed up with the fast-paced city life, Ramdas and his wife decide to move to a quiet bungalow on the outskirts of the city. However, some strange happenings in the surrounding put their lives at risk.
A young man's cross-country trip with his landlord's grandmother propels him into a journey of unexpected experiences and self-discovery.
With Isha by his side, DJ Shiva rises to a crescendo of love and fortitude to embrace his role as the chosen protector of the universe's most powerful weapon.
Four people, a supermarket employee, a little girl, a housewife and a college student, deal with their everyday problems in life and try their best to overcome them.
Gopan, a tourist guide, issues a statement against his rival, Kuriyachan, regarding a human trafficking case. However, Kuriyachan seeks revenge against Gopan.
The life of struggling news anchor, Engels Ramaswamy, and his family changes when a goddess appears before them. Later, with the help of the goddess, Engels sets out to expose fake godmen.
Ali Bhai, a goon, is the saviour of the poor in his dominion, Palayam market. However, when his enemies try to take over the market, he goes to great lengths to protect his stronghold and his people.
